name: Chitta Behavioral AI Chatbot
author: Chitta Team

sections.description:
Chitta replaces the passive nature of legacy chatbots with proactive Behavioral AI, becoming an indispensable active driver for website engagement and sales.

Chitta Behavioral AI leverages custom-trained AI models specifically designed to boost your conversion rates.

Chitta integrations are available in several formats to perfectly align with your website’s style and business strategy:

  1. Provocateur Sticker: A compact element that uses behavioral triggers to proactively engage passive visitors.
  2. Pop-up Sticker: A minimalist chat-style plate. It reveals a high-impact AI sticker upon click, using subtle nudges to turn visitors into leads without cluttering the screen.
  3. Website Info Block: A fully embedded AI interlocutor that can be placed anywhere on your page using shortcodes.
  4. Customer Support Chat: An automated support system for resolving queries and capturing leads.
  5. Knowledge Library for Personnel: A centralized, searchable AI information storage system for team efficiency.

Technology

Chitta is not a passive help desk on your website

  • Capture visitors’ interest with unexpected questions and animations.
  • Through intelligent dialogue, Chitta utilizes psychological algorithms and social influence principles to eliminate doubts and gently guide the visitor to a purchase.

Why Chitta?

  • Automatic integration creation directly within your WordPress admin dashboard.
  • This plugin allows the use of multiple integrations on one page, multilingual support, and WooCommerce compatibility.
  • Chitta captures qualified leads and can instantly sync them to your favorite CRM if needed.

Note: This plugin automatically connects to your Chitta account, enabling the full functionality of Chitta integrations.

Free Plan & Pricing

Start with our permanent FREE plan. This plan includes all core features of our behavioral AI, including psychological triggers and custom-trained models, with a small Powered by Chitta™ branding mark.

  • No Third-Party API Keys Needed: Chitta includes its own high-performance neural network resources. You don’t need to pay for OpenAI or Gemini separately.
  • Ready-to-Use Knowledge Base: Each plan includes managed knowledge base capacity to help the AI learn your business specifics.
  • Scalable Solutions: Choose a plan that fits your current needs and scale easily as your traffic grows.
    Check all Chitta pricing plans

Key Features

  • Style Isolation (Shadow DOM): The integration uses Shadow DOM technology to ensure styles never conflict with your website’s theme or other plugins.
  • Intelligent Display Rules: Precisely control where the integration appears using Include or Exclude modes for specific pages, posts, or products.
  • WooCommerce Friendly / Conversion Protection: Built-in options to hide the chat on Cart and Checkout pages to minimize distractions during the payment process.
  • Zero-Configuration Managed AI: Forget about complex API keys or choosing between LLM versions. Chitta automatically selects and fine-tunes the optimal AI model based on your niche, site content, and specific visitor behavior.
  • Advanced Multilingual Support: Seamlessly works with WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Weglot and other plugins. Supports dynamic language detection and switching without page reloads.
  • Shortcode Support: Simply copy your shortcode (e.g., [chitta id="123"]) directly from the plugin settings to place the AI assistant within specific content areas or layouts..
  • Smart Lead Generation: The AI identifies the optimal moment to request contact data after obtaining customer consent.
  • Universal CRM Integration: Connect Chitta to any CRM system or workflow platform using our flexible API.
  • Custom AI Tools: Create tools for the AI to call—like generating promo codes, checking order status, or triggering a custom task.
  • Multi-Widget Architecture: Deploy different AI assistants for different purposes (e.g., Info block on docs, Sticker on landing) on the exact same page.
  • Auto-Learning 24/7: Chitta acquires knowledge automatically from your website links, uploaded files, or manual text.
  • Secure and Privacy-Focused: No personal visitor data stored on your WordPress site.
  • Google Consent Mode Integration: Automatically synchronizes with your website’s Google-integrated Consent Window.
  • Automated Privacy Compliance: The system detects Google consent events to adjust AI behavior without extra configuration.

Perfect for Any Business

Chitta is designed to be a proactive consultant that adapts to your specific industry needs. It moves beyond passive support to drive actual sales through deep contextual understanding.

  • Personalized Retail & Gift Shops: Transform the shopping experience by having Chitta act as a personal assistant. The AI can help a user find a thoughtful gift for their wife, suggest the right toy for a child based on age, or recommend products within a specific budget.
  • Art, Decor & Custom Manufacturing: Simplify complex customer decisions. Chitta can help a visitor determine the ideal size and type of canvas for a painting or explain the technical differences between materials for custom-made furniture.
  • Engineering & Technical Components: Reduce the burden on your technical team. The AI can assist engineers in finding exact analogues for microchips, checking component specifications, or searching through thousands of pages of technical documentation in seconds.
  • Real Estate & High-Ticket Services: Capture and qualify leads at the moment of highest interest. Chitta identifies serious buyers, answers property-specific questions 24/7, and can even trigger custom tools to schedule viewings or appointments.
  • Medical & Beauty Clinics: Provide instant information on procedures and specialist availability. Help patients choose the right service or doctor and provide necessary pre-appointment guidance without manual intervention.
  • SaaS & Knowledge Bases: Improve user onboarding and self-service. Instead of a static FAQ, provide an interactive assistant that guides users through software features or documentation based on their real-time behavior.

Localization

Chitta™ Behavioral AI Chatbot is ready for global use. The plugin interface and AI settings are translated into 44 languages to ensure a seamless experience for you and your visitors:

  • English (en) | Українська (uk) | Русский (ru)
  • Deutsch (de) | Polski (pl) | Română (ro)
  • Қазақ тілі (kk) | Afrikaans (af) | বাংলা (bn)
  • Български (bg) | 中文 (zh) | Hrvatski (hr)
  • Čeština (cs) | Dansk (da) | Nederlands (nl)
  • Eesti (et) | Suomi (fi) | Français (fr)
  • Ελληνικά (el) | हिन्दी (hi) | Magyar (hu)
  • Íslenska (is) | Bahasa Indonesia (id) | Italiano (it)
  • 日本語 (ja) | 한국어 (ko) | Latviešu (lv)
  • Lietuvių (lt) | Монгол (mn) | Norsk Bokmål (nb)
  • Português (pt) | Português do Brasil (pt-br)
  • Srpski (sr) | Slovenčina (sk) | Slovenščina (sl)
  • Español (es) | Español (Argentina) (es-ar) | Español (México) (es-mx)
  • Kiswahili (sw) | Svenska (sv) | Tagalog (tl)
  • ภาษาไทย (th) | Türkçe (tr) | Tiếng Việt (vi)

External Services

This plugin connects your website to the Chitta AI platform (SaaS) to provide its functionality. It interacts with the following external service:

  • Service Provider: Chitta (https://chitta.site)
  • Purpose: Fetching integration configuration, processing AI logic via webhooks, and loading UI assets (CSS/Icons).
  • API Endpoint: https://chitta.site/config
  • Privacy Policy: https://chitta.site/chitta_site/documents/privacy_policy.html
  • Terms of Service: https://chitta.site/chitta_site/documents/terms.html

Third Party Libraries

For security and performance, this plugin bundles the following open-source libraries:

  • Marked.js (v17.0.5) – MIT License. Used for safe Markdown-to-HTML compilation.
  • DOMPurify (v3.3.3) – Mozilla Public License Version 2.0. Used for sanitizing AI responses to prevent XSS vulnerabilities.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chitta-behavioral-ai-chatbot directory, or install through the WordPress “Plugins” screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to Settings -> Chitta AI in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Launch the automatic setup directly from your admin panel.
  5. Configure display rules and WooCommerce visibility as needed.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Chitta account to use this plugin?

Yes. This plugin is the native integration for the Chitta Behavioral AI platform. To make it as easy as possible, you can launch the automatic setup directly from your WordPress admin panel. It will seamlessly connect your site to the Chitta service and prepare your AI integrations for action.

Is there a free plan available?

Yes! Chitta offers a permanent FREE plan. You get access to all basic features and behavioral triggers to see real results on your site. The FREE plan includes a small Powered by Chitta™ branding mark on the integration.

Do I need my own OpenAI or Gemini API key?

No. Chitta is a plug-and-play solution. We handle all technical aspects, including AI model selection and token costs. You get the best-performing AI without managing multiple accounts.

Does it work with AJAX-based themes?

Yes. The plugin uses a specialized MutationObserver to detect dynamic page transitions and ensure the integration initializes correctly on modern, fast-loading sites.

Can I send leads to my CRM?

Yes! Chitta features a powerful API that allows you to seamlessly connect your AI agent to literally any CRM system or external database.

Will it slow down my WordPress site?

No. The plugin is incredibly lightweight. The AI integrations scripts are loaded asynchronously, ensuring your Core Web Vitals remain unaffected.

Does it work with translation plugins like WPML or Polylang?

Absolutely! If you enable “Multilingual Mode” in the settings, it automatically detects the current language and switches the AI on the fly.

Can I use multiple integrations?

Yes. You can configure multiple integration instances and assign them to one or different pages.

Does this plugin collect personal data?

No. This plugin does not store or collect personal data on your WordPress database. All chat interactions are processed securely by the Chitta platform.

2.5.0

  • Feature: Added new referral program functionality.
  • Compatibility: Fully tested and optimized for WordPress 7.0.
  • Fix: Addressed minor CSS layout and styling issues across chat interfaces.

2.4.1

Minor fixes

2.4.0

  • Feature: Added voice input functionality with a dynamic loading indicator and click-safeguards.
  • Updated and optimized the positioning of chat widget elements.
  • Minor CSS fixes and style adjustments for better mobile responsiveness and layout stability.

2.3.0

  • Feature: Added support for multi-level popup menus in the chat interface. This allows for more complex navigation and hierarchical conversation flows.
  • Fix: Resolved various CSS and JS issues to improve layout stability and script performance across different browsers.

2.2.2

  • Fix: Minor CSS styling improvements and layout consistency.

2.2.1

  • Improved error reporting: Added detailed descriptions for errors occurring during the site analysis and training process.
  • UI Fixes: Minor CSS adjustments to improve the layout and responsiveness.

2.2.0

  • Business Model Update: Replaced the limited-time trial with a permanent, full-featured FREE plan.
  • Branding: The FREE plan now allows indefinite use of all basic features with a small Powered by Chitta™ branding.
  • New Feature: Added direct management control for the “Contact Manager” button within the plugin settings.
  • Refinements: Minor CSS and JavaScript optimizations for improved stability and performance.

2.1.0

  • Automated Visual Adaptation: Integration themes are now dynamically generated based on your website’s CSS and style patterns to ensure a native look and feel.
  • UI Refinement: Polished the settings page for a cleaner look and better navigation.
  • Onboarding Optimization: Simplified the connection process to make it faster for new users.
  • Security Update: Minor security patches and improved data validation during integration.
  • CSS optimization: Patched layout inconsistencies and resolved style inheritance issues for better compatibility with various WordPress themes.

2.0.2

  • Updated plugin description for better clarity.
  • Fixed and improved translations across supported languages.

2.0.1

  • Tweak: Minor CSS styling improvements for better UI consistency.
  • Update: Updated JavaScript and CSS asset versioning to prevent caching issues.

2.0.0

  • Major Update: Introduced full automation for a seamless onboarding experience.
  • Added automatic registration – get started with Chitta without manual sign-ups.
  • Added automatic integration creation – manage and deploy AI integrations directly from your WordPress admin dashboard.
  • New UI/UX – completely redesigned plugin interface for better usability and control.
  • Multilingual Support – automatic translation creation for multi-language websites (WPML, Polylang, etc.).
  • Performance optimizations and stability improvements.

1.0.4

  • Enhanced Theme Compatibility: Refined CSS styles and interface elements to ensure seamless visual integration with a broader variety of WordPress themes, especially those with aggressive global CSS resets.
  • Interface Improvements: Minor dashboard layout optimizations for better readability and responsiveness within the WordPress admin area.
  • CSS Specificity Fixes: Adjusted internal styling rules to prevent third-party theme styles from affecting the AI integration’s core components.

1.0.3

  • Improved Autostart Logic: The “Autostart” parameter is now enabled by default for all new integrations, ensuring the AI assistant activates immediately after you save your Channel ID.
  • Settings Preservation Fix: Resolved a specific issue where the autostart status could reset to disabled during the very first save of a new integration configuration.
  • Enhanced UI Reliability: Implemented mandatory state passing for checkboxes located within hidden “Advanced Usage” sections to ensure all configurations are accurately stored in the database.

1.0.2

  • Experience Chitta™ in Action: Added a new live interactive demo block to the admin settings page, allowing you to see the AI behavior immediately after installation.
  • Global Localization: Added full support for 44 languages with native naming in the documentation and improved the translation engine.
  • Translation Engine Fixes: Improved .PO/.MO/.PHP synchronization logic and fixed a bug where “Array” strings could appear in translation files.
  • UI/CSS Refinements: Minor CSS adjustments for the admin dashboard, including better integration of the demo integration and custom property fixes for the chat footer.
  • Stability: Enhanced recursion protection when loading translation files to prevent memory issues on specific server configurations.

1.0.1

  • Added a dynamic account status banner to the settings dashboard.
  • Updated trial logic: 10-day period now starts only after the first integration is created.
  • Integrated a feedback-based bonus system for an additional 5 free days.
  • Improved UI: Widget settings are now hidden until a valid Channel ID is saved for a cleaner experience.
  • Fixed SVN MIME-types for animated GIF icons to ensure proper display in the repository.

1.0.0

  • Initial official release.
  • Implemented Shadow DOM encapsulation for CSS isolation.
  • Added granular display rules (All pages / Include / Exclude).
  • Added WooCommerce Cart and Checkout visibility toggles.
  • Integrated dynamic language detection for WPML, Polylang, and TranslatePress.
